title: SalesDashboard loads ALL contracts and MSAs with no $top cap and no active_flag filter
detail: Line 62: `apiGet('/dcfg_contracts?$select=dcfg_contractid,dcfg_status,...')` — no $filter for dcfg_active_flag eq true, no $top. Loads every contract ever created including soft-deleted. Line 63: same for MSAs (no filter at all). Line 64: same for customers (no filter, no $top). Dashboard is flagged as 'no caching - fresh fetch every mount' (line 4 comment JS-10), so every route change to / re-runs these. At current scale (~200 contracts) this is fine. At 2,000 contracts the dashboard becomes the single most expensive page load in the SPA.
recommendedFix: Add filters where appropriate: contracts `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true`, MSAs `$filter=statecode eq 0`, customers `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true`. Add `$top=500` as a safety cap. Consider computing KPI values via a server-side Power Automate rollup stored in dcfg_configs so the dashboard reads 5 numbers instead of thousands of rows.

title: SalesDashboard imports useRef, useMemo, isManager — none are used
detail: Line 6: `import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';` — useRef, useMemo, useCallback are never used in the file. Line 41: `const { isManager } = usePortalUser();` — isManager never used.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:6, 41. grep confirms no other references in this file.
recommendedFix: Trim imports to `import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';`. Remove the isManager destructure.

title: Pipeline bar segments are interactive divs with no keyboard access or ARIA roles
detail: Lines 162-178: each pipeline segment is a <div> with onClick and mouse handlers but no role='button', no tabIndex, and no keyboard event handler. Screen readers cannot navigate these, and keyboard-only users cannot click them. Each segment navigates to /contracts?status=N so this is functional content, not decorative.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:163 `<div key={status} ... onClick={() => navigate(...)}` — no role, tabIndex, or onKeyDown.
recommendedFix: Add `role='button'` and `tabIndex={0}` to each pipeline segment div. Add `onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') navigate(...); }}` for keyboard activation.

title: Pipeline legend color swatches lack alt text for color-blind users
detail: Line 183: each legend entry uses a colored <span> as the only indicator of which pipeline segment it refers to. The status text is adjacent but there is no programmatic association between the swatch and the label. Users who cannot distinguish the colors rely solely on the text ordering to match legend to bar.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:183 — colored span has no aria-label or role='img' with alt.
recommendedFix: Add `role='img'` and `aria-label={STATUS_LABELS[status]}` to each legend color swatch span.

title: KpiTile is a clickable div with no keyboard accessibility
detail: Lines 302-328: KpiTile renders an onClick div with hover effects and cursor:pointer but no role='button', no tabIndex, and no onKeyDown handler. Three KPI tiles on the dashboard navigate to /contracts and /send-queue. Keyboard-only users cannot reach or activate these tiles.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:305 `onClick={onClick}` on a plain <div> — no role, tabIndex, or keyboard handler.
recommendedFix: Add `role='button'`, `tabIndex={0}`, and `onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') onClick(); }}` to the KpiTile root div.

title: Dead code: `fmt` and `btnStyles` are defined but never used
detail: Line 375: function `fmt(val)` formats currency but is never called in SalesDashboard. Line 391: `btnStyles.primary` object is defined but never referenced. Both are dead code from a prior iteration.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:375 `function fmt(val)`, line 391 `const btnStyles`. grep for 'fmt(' and 'btnStyles' in this file returns only the definitions.

title: Onboarding status badge uses hardcoded magic number 100000001
detail: Line 211: `c.dcfg_status === 100000001 ? 'In Progress' : 'New'` uses a raw integer. The same constant exists as OnboardingCaseStatus.InProgress in portalApi.js but is not imported here.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:211 and 212 — raw `100000001` comparisons for status badge styling.
recommendedFix: Import OnboardingCaseStatus from portalApi.js and use `OnboardingCaseStatus.InProgress` instead of the raw number.

title: Activity log contract link uses <a href> instead of navigate() — causes full page reload in SPA
detail: Line 282: `<a href={'/contracts/${log.dcfg_related_contract_id}'}` uses a raw anchor tag. In a HashRouter SPA, this causes a full browser navigation instead of a client-side route transition — losing all in-memory state.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:282 `View` — should be navigate() or .
recommendedFix: Replace the `<a>` with a `<span>` or `<button>` using `onClick={() => navigate('/contracts/' + log.dcfg_related_contract_id)}`, or use `<Link to={...}>` from react-router-dom.

title: customerMap is built on every render but never consumed
detail: Line 102: `const customerMap = Object.fromEntries(customers.map(...))` builds a lookup map on every render. The comment says 'kept for data layer compatibility' but no code in the file reads from customerMap.
evidence: SalesDashboard.jsx:102 — customerMap defined, grep for 'customerMap' in this file returns only the definition line.
recommendedFix: Remove the customerMap computation. If it is needed in the future, wrap it in useMemo.
